title: Elevator Music
blurb: Aggressively pleasant, engineered to be heard without being listened to, and originally supplied by a company called Muzak that studied precisely how to do that. The blandness is a design achievement rather than a failure. As a meme sound it thrives on discomfort: play it during an argument nobody will break, a question nobody will answer, or the pause after somebody says something they cannot take back. It transforms dead air into a hotel lobby, which is a considerably crueller thing to do than shouting. Soothing, sterile, savage in context.
origin: Classic hold/elevator muzak, the official soundtrack of awkward waiting.
